title: Little Passports Alternatives: 6 Boxes for Kids - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for a Little Passports alternative? Compare six kids' boxes by age, price, and theme, from world mysteries and geography kits to weekly letters.
body_markdown:
## Questions before switching


Which alternative is closest to Little Passports?


For World Adventures, Finders Seekers Junior Explorers is the closest on Cratejoy: a new world culture each month for ages 5 to 10 and up, told as a mystery. KiwiCo Atlas Crate is the closest outside Cratejoy if your kid would rather build.


What comes after World Adventures?


World Adventures visits 12 countries, and Little Passports suggests Science Expeditions next. For a kid who wants to keep traveling, Backpack The World covers 19 countries for ages 9 to 15.


Is there a Little Passports alternative for preschoolers?


Snail Mail for Kids is made for ages 3 to 8, with a plush snail and a weekly letter about Sunny’s travels. Finders Seekers Junior Explorers starts at age 5.


What about Little Passports’ science lines?


For Science Junior or Science Expeditions, look at hands-on science boxes. Green Kid Crafts sends science and craft activities for ages 5 to 10 and up, and our[KiwiCo alternatives guide](https://www.cratejoy.com/blogs/box-insider/kiwico-alternatives) compares more science and maker boxes.


Can I send one of these as a gift?


Yes. The five Cratejoy boxes here each offer a Give as a Gift option on their listing. Little Passports and KiwiCo both sell gift subscriptions on their own sites, and Little Passports adds a gift message to the first package.
